crime_highlights: Mr. Smith take a knife from a young girl standing nearby and plunge the knife into the victim's face
The attack on the victim was unprovoked and swift.
the victim bleeding profusely from his face immediately following the stabbing
rationale_highlights: Mr. Smith's particular background reveals the consequences of systemic discrimination
I find that Mr. Smith's unique background factors played a part in bringing Mr. Smith before the Court in this case and therefore mitigate his moral culpability.
Mr. Smith's degree of moral blameworthiness is reduced on account of the s. 718.2(e) factors.

crime_highlights: T.P., a teenager, recognized the risk and repeatedly asked Ms. Dyck to take K.P. to the hospital, but she never did.
Ms. Dyck, at least in the month of July 2021, was inexplicably unable or unwilling to provide that basic level of support to her daughter.
As of result of her failure to procure urgent medical attention for her daughter, K.P. died from the cumulative effect of several injuries.
rationale_highlights: I must have regard to those personal circumstances which might serve to mitigate or aggravate culpability.
I find that Ms. Dyck has a significantly reduced level of moral blameworthiness, when one considers the long list of applicable factors described in her Gladue report.
These personal circumstances are a crucial factor in coming to a fit and proportionate sentence.
The intergenerational effects of residential school are directly connected to Ms. Dyck's substance use disorder.
note: Manslaughter by omission; facts of injuries from agreed statement.

crime_highlights: Mr. Aldridge who, without warning, grabbed him by the head and kneed him to the ground and proceeded to kick and stomp on his head
Although Mr. Wheeler lost consciousness, Mr. Aldridge continued to attack him.
He sustained a fractured skull, multiple facial factures, intracranial haemorrhaging, fractured ribs, and a traumatic brain injury.
He was in a coma for 23 days.
He will require permanent care for the rest of his life.
rationale_highlights: He was subject to racist taunting at an Indigenous school.
I find Mr. Aldridge's moral culpability is reduced by reason of the Gladue factors identified in the Gladue report, which I accept.
Were it not for Mr. Aldridge's reduced moral culpability, I would have little difficulty concluding that an appropriate sentence would have been within the range of six to eight years
